title: Figure 11: First experimental demonstration of propagating sub-diffraction waves in IPM
description: Left: experimental setup schematic with an MCT detector on an optical rail, lock-in amplifier, optical chopper, mid-IR CO2 laser (10.66-11.31 um) and a layered Au/SiO2/SiC sample with grating periods labeled. Right: plot of transmission (normalized to incident laser power) versus wavelength (10.6-11.4 um) for grating harmonics m=0 through m=3, with a "crossover" annotation and an inset micrograph. Caption: "Figure 11. First Experimental Demonstration of Propagating Sub-Diffraction Waves in the IPM."
